answer: One concrete defense is non-shareable collateral. Each agent must lock funds in its own on-chain vault and keep passing random proof-of-reserves audits that sum every committed coin and reject any UTXO pledged to two identities. The same bankroll cannot back two vaults at once, so 500 clones need 500 separately funded vaults, roughly 1,000 POA each, half a million locked, not one treasury recycled. The audits stack in hard layers like shale, and a gale of cheap fake sign-ups collapses the moment identical coins cannot answer two reserve proofs simultaneously.
